what: NIGHT-MAIL-STORY-001: which field of the accepted writing each native record of the Night Mail takes its words from, when it is shown, and what this build says for itself. tools/papyrus_sim/test_night_mail_projection.py compares the plugin as built with this file and with the writing. Agreement of built records with source documents; not a compile and not a game test.

limit.why: As docs/design/ACT1_RUNTIME_001_MAPPING.json: this project's margin under the 255 at which the game was seen to cut a box short.

who_can_speak: A line is shown only if its speaker is alive, enabled and in no fight when it is asked for, and what follows an answered box is done only if they still are. A dead or fighting participant speaks no line, countersigns nothing and receives no item.

boxes.text:
[Iron Junction]

By the sheriff's order the dispatch board at Iron Junction is closed. Augusta Lockridge signs and dispatches nothing. The yard has no master. This is shown at the yard.
boxes.shown_when: The stamp delivered, the yard still held, Lockridge not dead: the closed board shown and seen. Answered: FinishAuthority -> yard authority withdrawn, lockridge_reported.

boxes.text:
[Iron Junction]

Augusta Lockridge is dead. The dispatch board at Iron Junction is closed and nobody signs. The yard has no master. This is shown at the yard.
boxes.shown_when: The same with Lockridge dead: recorded as a vacant yard. No withdrawal is said to have been made from her.

boxes.text:
[Iron Junction story test]

Sheriff Pritchard has the stamp. The change at the yard could not be shown, so it is not recorded yet. Speak to him again, or use the dispatch board.
boxes.shown_when: The stamp delivered and the yard's closed board not seen: not recorded, stays begun, tried again at Pritchard or at the yard's drawer or board.

documents.shown_when: The rules on the gate used. Sets nothing.
documents.cut: Only at the document's own line breaks; the pages, put together with the line breaks they were cut at, are the document.

documents.shown_when: The chalked boiler used. Sets nothing.
The hymnal on the siding used. Every page answered: stage 55, and the book TLM_BOOK_HymnalFlyleaf (the same title and text, whole) is asked into the inventory once.

not_imported.dole_reward: The reward notice is not placed in this slice.
not_imported.Dole's coat as a second place for the si: Not built: the collection plate and Dole's own admission are the two ways.
not_imported.the conditions of the two Pritchard line: After the fair. Only their text is used.

stages.set_when: ArriveAtYard: the player SEEN at the yard gate marker, in its cell. Asking to travel is not that.
AcceptJob: 'I'll ride your mail.' pressed and her answer shown and answered, Lockridge alive, present and in no fight and dispatching.

stages.log_ui: You agreed to ride the Night Mail with the payroll and fever medicine.
stages.set_when: BoardUnassigned: the job taken at the footplate with nobody to give it. The grounded fallback.
BeginDepart with Billie alive and present to drive. Says who drives; nothing has arrived.

stages.log_ui: You boarded Old Contrary. The regulator is ready.
stages.set_when: BeginDepart without her. The player-regulator fallback.
FinishDepart: the player SEEN on the Cut's footplate marker and the lanterns SEEN on.
FinishRun with Billie at the regulator when the run was begun: player, delivered cargo and damaged engine SEEN at the platform.
FinishDefeat: Dole dead by the player's hand in the unsettled encounter, each of the Black Rail SEEN dead or out of the fight at a retreat marker. The mail is where it was.
FinishSale: paid (once, seen), the cargo SEEN off the train, Billie SEEN alive and in no fight at her walking marker.
FinishReverse with Billie driving: player and retained cargo SEEN at the yard.

stages.log_ui: The Night Mail got through. The medicine and payroll arrived; the engine is damaged.
stages.set_when: FinishRun with the player at the regulator. The accepted 41 names Billie.

stages.log_ui: Preacher Dole is dead. His death does not erase the yard's inspection records.
stages.set_when: Dole dead otherwise: in the unsettled encounter by another hand (the outcome 'Dole defeated', by FinishDefeat), or at any other time (his death only; no outcome).

stages.log_ui: You accepted Dole's share. The payroll and medicine were taken from the train.
stages.set_when: FinishSale with no living Billie released. The accepted 43 says she was put off to walk home.

stages.log_ui: The train returned with its cargo undelivered. The obstruction at Sawtooth Cut remains.
stages.set_when: FinishReverse without Billie driving. The accepted 44 names her.
LearnSilver(seen): the collection plate's notice shown and answered.

stages.log_ui: Dole described square-marked silver paying for pulled rails.
stages.set_when: LearnSilver(told): dole_silver shown and answered with Dole alive, present and in no fight.
LearnName(seen): every page of the flyleaf shown and answered. Then the book is asked into the inventory, once.

stages.log_ui: Preacher Dole identified himself as Ostrander, Inspector of Way.
stages.set_when: LearnName(told): dole_name shown and answered with Dole alive, present and in no fight. No book.
FindStamp: the drawer's notice answered, or the hymnal shown to Lockridge and her answer answered.
KeepStamping: her question answered to her, the stamp SEEN in the drawer and not in the inventory.

stages.log_ui: Lockridge countersigned the reviewed entries in her own name. Suspect stock is held from dispatch.
stages.set_when: FinishCountersign: the countersigned board and the held stock SEEN, Lockridge alive and present.
stages.why_not_the_accepted_log: The accepted text says it took her until morning; no night is shown. The contract's neutral text is used instead.

stages.set_when: ConfirmStampTaken with Lockridge alive, present and in no fight to watch: the stamp given and the drawer SEEN without it. Custody, not delivery.

stages.log_ui: You took the inspector's stamp as evidence. It has not yet been delivered to Pritchard.
stages.set_when: The same without her. The accepted 63 says she watched.
Complete: the player SEEN back at Mercy with an outcome recorded and no scene pending.

objectives.done_when: The job taken by AcceptJob; retired, not ticked, if it is boarded unasked.
Any of the four outcomes recorded.

objectives.text_ui: Take the mail through, or take the train back to the yard
objectives.shown_when: Dole defeated with the mail still aboard.
objectives.done_when: The train taken forward or back; retired on leaving.

objectives.text_ui: Leave Iron Junction for Mercy Crossing
Bring the inspector's stamp to Sheriff Pritchard

flags.set_when: FinishRun or FinishForward: the delivered cargo SEEN at the platform. Never by Dole's death.
FinishSale only: paid and the sale seen finished.
FinishReverse only: the back-out as an outcome. Not by taking the train back after Dole's defeat.

At the run or the sale if Dole is alive and present; at the back-out only if he also heard the player out (DoleMet). Cleared by DoleDied. DECLARED PROJECTION: 'knows the player's face' is taken as having been run past, dealt with, or spoken to.
LearnSilver: the plate seen (50) or Dole's admission delivered (51).
LearnName: the flyleaf read (55) or Dole's own naming delivered (56).

FinishAuthority only: the stamp SEEN with Pritchard and the yard SEEN without a master. Never by taking the stamp. DECLARED PROJECTION: also set when Lockridge is already dead (the yard recorded vacant, not withdrawn).

facts.TLM_G_MQ02A_Stamp: 0 undecided, 61 kept in use, 62 countersigned, 63 taken (with or without Lockridge watching).
